attach_oauth_to_fastapi: attach OAuth login callback routes and session middleware to a FastAPI application
add_oauth_routes: add Hugging Face OAuth login and callback routes to a FastAPI app with environment variable validation
handle_oauth_login_redirect: handle the OAuth login redirect to the Hugging Face authorization page for a FastAPI request
handle_oauth_callback: handle the OAuth callback from Hugging Face and store user info in the session
redirect_to_target_url: redirect a request to a target URL from query parameters or a default path
